units: <cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 3:4">Ukts. III, 4</cite> <he>הש׳ משנתן טעמו וכ׳</he> (Ar. <he>משנתנה טעמה</he>) the dill stalk after having given its taste to a dish; <cite ref="Berakhot 39a">Ber. 39ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 4:5">Maasr. IV, 5</cite> <he>הש׳ מתעשרת וכ׳</he> dill must be tithed as seed &c., v. <cite ref="P01503"><he>עָשַׂר</he></cite>; a. fr.
